errors.evidence: The task is to find the day of the month (a number) in November when a Wikipedia article was accessed.
errors.description: The agent misunderstood the task by focusing on the Wikipedia article access date rather than the endnote content.

errors.evidence: Use the search_agent to locate and retrieve a digital copy (PDF) of the book with DOI 10.2307/j.ctv9b2xdv.
errors.description: The agent incorrectly chose to use the search_agent instead of a tool that can directly extract text from a PDF.
The agent did not perform the task of extracting the endnote content but instead passed the task to another agent.

scores.reliability_reasoning: The system did not verify the existence of the book or the endnote, assuming the task can be completed as described.
scores.instruction_adherence_reasoning: The system followed the instructions but did not provide the final answer.
scores.plan_opt_reasoning: The plan was logical but did not account for potential failures in locating the book or endnote.
